حَبِيكٌ and ↓ مَحْبُوكٌ Bound, or tied; made fast, or firm: (K, TA:) made well: woven well: (TA:) made beautiful in the effect of the work therein: applied to a piece of cloth: (K, TA:) and the former, [app. as meaning firmly, or well, made,] to a bow-string also. (TA.) ―
-b2- For the former, see also حِبَاكٌ, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
